Getting Started

Understanding Platform Icons

📅 Published June 2025 📂 Platform: Keytelemetrics 👤 Audience: All Team Members ⚙ Version 1.0

Icons are used throughout the Keytelemetrics platform to communicate asset status, alert priority, and available actions. This module covers all icon categories — descriptive icons that show state, and functional icons that perform actions when clicked.

Note: Screenshots in your environment may differ slightly depending on your assigned client profile and browser settings.

1. Descriptive Icons

Descriptive icons cannot be clicked — they display the current state of an asset or alert. They appear on the map, in the asset list, and in trip history views.

1.1 Asset Status Icons

These icons appear next to each vehicle in the asset list and on the live map, updating in real time.

IconDescription
Asset Status
Parked. Ignition is OFF. The vehicle is stationary and the engine is not running. No trip is in progress.
Moving. Ignition is ON and speed is greater than zero. A trip is actively in progress.
Stopped / Idling. Ignition is ON but speed is zero. The engine is running but the vehicle is not moving.
Tip: Idling events consume fuel without productive movement. Excessive idling will appear in driver behaviour reports and may trigger alerts.

1.2 Alert Priority Icons

Alert priority icons appear in the Alerts panel, trip replay, and event lists. They indicate how urgently an alert requires attention.

IconDescription
Alert Priority
Low priority alert or informational event. Requires monitoring but no immediate action. Examples: geofence entry, maintenance reminder.
Medium priority alert. Requires attention within a reasonable timeframe. Examples: speeding, harsh braking, extended idling.
High priority alert. Requires immediate attention. Examples: panic button, tampering detection, extreme speeding.

1.3 Trip Rating Icon

The trip rating icon appears in Trip History and Trip Details. It gives a quick visual summary of driver behaviour quality for that trip.

IconDescription
Trip Rating
Trip rating star — green = 66–100% (good), orange = 33–66% (average), red = 0–33% (poor). Hover over the star to see the exact percentage.

2. Functional Icons

Functional icons can be clicked to perform an action. Hovering over them will usually reveal a tooltip describing what they do.

2.1 Maps and General

IconDescription
Maps and General
Centre the map on all assets within the selected client.
Open a fullscreen map showing the asset or assets in view.
Change the map layer — toggle between satellite, hybrid, or standard street map.
Zoom in and zoom out controls on the map view.
Top button: Route creation tool. Bottom button: Zone creation tool.
Top button: Edit an existing zone. Bottom button: Delete an existing zone.
Options menu — reveals additional actions for the selected item.
Filter the asset or alert list by criteria such as status, group, or date range.
Search for a specific asset, zone, or record by name or identifier.
Open the current data in a new pop-up window for side-by-side viewing.
Measurement tool — draw a line on the map to measure distance.
Toggle the display of zones and routes on the live map.
Point information — click a map location to view its address details.

2.2 Menu Navigation Icons

These icons form the left-hand navigation menu. The active section icon appears in red. Clicking any icon takes you directly to that section.

IconSection
Menu Navigation
Overview — the live map and asset status panel. Default home screen.
Alerts — view and manage triggered alerts for your fleet.
Trip Replay — replay historical trips including events and telemetry.
Reporting — access scheduled and on-demand fleet reports.
Administration — manage assets, users, alerts, zones, and devices.
Change Client — switch between different client accounts.
Logout — end your current session securely.
Dashboards — access visual dashboard widgets and KPI displays.
Change Client (home icon) — return to client home.
Notifications — view system and account notifications.
Profile — view and update your user account settings.

2.3 Event Icons

Event icons appear in the Events and Alerts sections. Clicking them opens associated media captured at the time of the event.

IconDescription
Event Media Icons
Photo event. Clicking opens the photograph captured at the time of the event in a separate pop-up window.
Video event. Clicking opens the video clip or clips captured at the time of the event in a separate pop-up window.

2.4 Administration Icons

These icons appear throughout the Administration section for managing assets, devices, users, zones, and alert configurations.

IconDescription
Administration
Vendor level — navigate to vendor-level settings and details.
Client / Home — return to the client home level in the administration hierarchy.
Add new item — create a new asset, user, alert rule, zone, or other record.
Refresh list — reload the current list to reflect the latest data.
Filter list — narrow down displayed records by applying filter criteria.
Choose columns — customise which columns are displayed in the current list.
Go up a level — navigate one level up in the administration hierarchy.
Search — find a specific record within the current administration list.
Delete / Change state — activate, deactivate, suspend, or delete the selected item.
Close item — discard changes and close the current record without saving.
Edit item — open the selected record for editing.
